visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a spoon scooping creamy, yellow pudding from a brown milk tea beverage in a plastic cup. Below this overlay, a man with shoulder-length wavy dark hair and a white textured shirt holds two drinks. (2) The man is shown from the chest up, drinking from a straw and then talking with an expressive, surprised face. (3) Sequence of close-ups showing the pudding's texture as it's lifted from the cup, mixed with ice and milk tea. The man reappears, gesturing with his hands to emphasize his words. (4) Close-up of hands using a calligraphy brush to write large black characters on a bright red strip of paper. (5) The man stands on a grey couch in a brightly lit room with white walls, proudly holding up a long red calligraphy banner. A woman in a red shirt is briefly visible holding the other end of the banner. (6) Detailed shots of a different milk tea variant containing dark pearls and the same yellow pudding. The man is shown drinking and reacting with a look of pure enjoyment. (7) Another writing sequence where the man creates a second red banner and then holds it while posing with a cup. (8) Four different plastic cups of milk tea are lined up on a wooden table. The man holds two of them while explaining the product line. (9) The man sits at a table with calligraphy tools. A hand enters from the side holding a smartphone. He looks at the screen, rolls his eyes upward until only the whites show, and drops his brush in an exaggerated comedic gesture.

(5) [Subtitle]: 非常好吃 口感非常豐富. (6) [Subtitle]: 第一次喝到飲料加布蕾 一定要幫它取個響當當的名字. (7) [Subtitle]: 牙蕾牙蕾! 捨不得喝完布蕾紅茶拿鐵. (8) [Subtitle]: 黑糖珍珠鮮奶+布蕾. (9) [Subtitle]: 黑糖珍珠鮮奶本身就很好喝了 搭配布蕾絲滑口感 兩者緊密結合一起 有嚼勁又有甜味. visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male creator, 1 female assistant appearing briefly in the middle and end.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A man with wavy, shoulder-length black hair, wearing a white short-sleeved textured or knit shirt and a beaded bracelet on his left wrist.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A simple indoor setting with grey couches, white walls, an air conditioner, and a wooden table with calligraphy supplies. Some shots feature a checkered pattern overlay.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins over an upbeat electronic pop track. The voice is enthusiastic and well-articulated. (2) A clear liquid slurping sound occurs as the man drinks. He continues describing the pudding's smoothness with rising intonation and exaggerated emphasis. (3) A subtle scratching sound of a brush on paper is heard alongside the speech. (4) The man shouts 'Hey!' with high arousal, followed by a brief giggle from a woman in the background. (5) Another slurping sound precedes a description of a black sugar pearl beverage. The BGM remains consistent with a steady 4/4 beat. (6) A dramatic shift in vocal delivery as the man reads his 'creative' product names, using a more theatrical tone. (7) An impact sound occurs as the man drops his brush, followed by a 'ding' cartoon sound effect. The music fades out into a second of silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Detailed Product Review -> Creative Interlude -> Second Product Review -> Creative Interlude -> Call to Action -> Comedic Twist
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the new 'Brulee' (pudding) beverage series from the brand Truedan. The creator uses an energetic food review style combined with a humorous segment where he writes calligraphy banners to give the drinks funny, unofficial names, creating an engaging and memorable advertisement.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The brand logo is prominently displayed, the speaker explicitly names the brand and products, and the entire content is focused on reviewing their new menu items.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses high-energy performance and meme-style editing (eye-rolling, sound effects) to keep viewers engaged with a commercial product.
